title: The Superannuated Flagship
logline: A dying naval commodore leaves his vintage armored gunboat to his squabbling heirs on the condition they navigate an active live-fire proving ground together.

roles.description: High-strung station broker; anxious, resentful of military tradition, desperate to sell the gunboat to cover trading losses.
Freelance hotshot pilot; reckless, sentimental, determined to keep the armored family heirloom flying.
Naval estate executor; austere, pedantic, holding the deceased commodore's encrypted launch codes in escrow.
An aggressive salvage raider attempting to disable the gunboat during the proving trial to strip its armor plate.
An independent shipbuilders' guild maintaining historical drydocks and armor refits.
An abandoned orbital ordnance range strewn with unexploded target drones and magnetic tether mines.
A historic drydock where the gunboat must dock to formally ratify the testamentary transfer.

public_situation: An antique armored naval gunboat is fueled at {role:heritage_shipyard} as the late commodore's estranged children prepare for a mandatory proving flight.
private_truth: The commodore's testamentary trial was designed to force his estranged children to cooperate, but scrap pirates have learned the gunboat's weapons are unloaded.

beats.public_change: The naval notary unseals the testamentary protocol at {role:heritage_shipyard}, requiring an outside pilot to escort the heirloom craft.

missions.reason: Collect the biometric testamentary seal and flight telemetry recorder from the estate office to monitor the siblings' compliance.
missions.private_fact: The commodore privately instructed the notary that if the siblings abandon the trial, the vessel passes entirely to naval scrap reserves.

beats.public_change: The heirloom gunboat enters {role:naval_breach_range}, where scrap scavengers ambush the unarmed vessel.

missions.reason: Scavengers blow off the gunboat's secondary coolant pod; destroy the lead raider and retrieve the ejected pod before reactor heat spikes.
missions.private_fact: He secretly tried to hire scavengers to fake an engine breakdown so he could collect the estate's insurance value early.

beats.public_change: Rogue naval training drones activate inside the firing range, boxing the heirs against the outer minefield boundary.

missions.reason: Destroy the remaining scavenger escorts attempting to corral the gunboat into the live mine perimeter.
missions.private_fact: She forged her late father's logbook entries to make it look like she completed her naval flight cadet exams.

missions.reason: Deliver the telemetry recorder back to the notary's bench to certify that the proving run was completed under testamentary conditions.
missions.private_fact: The commodore left a hidden safe deposit slip aboard the gunboat containing ten thousand credits of unmarked bullion.

player_choice.prompt: The trial is complete and the gunboat is safely berthed. The heirs disagree violently on what to do with the inherited warship.

options.label: Persuade the siblings to form a joint charter company to operate the gunboat as an independent heavy escort
Help the elder sibling buy out the younger's share with private broker loans to scrap the hull for debt relief
Help the younger sibling secure independent bank credit to buy out the elder and keep the ship flying

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a partnership between the siblings, fulfilling the commodore's intent.
resolutions.summary: The siblings reconcile and establish an armed freight escort line. {role:elder_sibling} manages contracts while {role:younger_sibling} flies the heirloom.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot escorted an antique gunboat through a live-fire proving ground to unite two estranged siblings.

resolutions.reached_by: The elder sibling liquidates the vessel to satisfy pressing broker debts.
resolutions.summary: The gunboat is cut up for armor plate. {role:elder_sibling} clears his trading debts, while {role:younger_sibling} leaves the system in bitter estrangement.

resolutions.reached_by: The younger sibling secures independent finance and assumes sole command.
resolutions.summary: {role:younger_sibling} takes sole title of the armored warship, taking high-risk bounty contracts while {role:elder_sibling} faces bankruptcy.

resolutions.reached_by: The flight trial fails or the gunboat is crippled inside the range.
resolutions.summary: The proving trial fails. The commodore's gunboat reverts to naval scrap reserves, leaving both {role:elder_sibling} and {role:younger_sibling} disinherited.

loose_threads.detail: A private lien against the gunboat's main drive core was registered by a loan syndicate forty-eight hours before the commodore passed away.
Navigational radar arrays monitoring the ordnance range were quietly dialed down during the trial window.
The lead scrapper vessel carried a pre-signed bill of lading for thirty tons of heavy hull plate stamped by a municipal scrap broker.

radio_hooks: Naval probate court oversees testing of late commodore's armored personal gunboat.
Civilian traffic warned away from perimeter of decommissioned live-fire proving ranges.
Shipyard mechanics marvel at pristine state of antique naval pulse cannon mountings.

voice_direction.elder_sibling: High-pitched, breathless, and resentful. Speaks rapidly about numbers and expenses, viewing every tradition as a personal financial attack.
voice_direction.younger_sibling: Bravura, loud, and defensive. Uses military jargon incorrectly and overcompensates for feeling dismissed by her elder brother.
voice_direction.testament_notary: Monotone, glacial, and formal. Delivers catastrophic legal news with identical unhurried inflection as weather forecasts.
